message:
In the 48-volt Lithium Iron Phosphate battery bank (Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4), long-life lithium chemistry) (C3), Sam, the ice-to-electric conversion method has missing divisor problem. To check it I used whiteboard read-across of the ice-bank latent estimate (E23). I found 9.28 kilowatt-hours thermal with no Coefficient of Performance (Coefficient of Performance (COP), cooling per electricity) divisor, according to Council Whiteboard, 2026. I propose Sam divides thermal kilowatt-hours by Coefficient of Performance to close combined days. My position: not ready because battery plus ice autonomy stays unproven.

In the tilted-roof monocrystalline Photovoltaic array (Photovoltaic (PV), sunlight-to-electricity panels) (C2), Maya, the upsized array support method has unverified bearing problem. To check it I used area review reusing the photovoltaic area estimate (E24). I found 20.3 square metres for 4 kilowatts, according to Trina Solar, 2024. I propose Maya confirms canopy posts and footings before freezing size. My position: not ready because cloudy refill must remain buildable.
Note on Sam: conversion of ice thermal to electrical requested.
Note on Maya: canopy support confirmation requested.
